list: The official 55 trophies, as listed 18 November 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. The long gate is A Long Road: 100% completion, which takes around 200 hours in total, so treat the platinum as a marathon, not a sprint. There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so nothing is locked behind multiplayer or a hard mode.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn. Story trophies pop as you play; there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter in case you need to go back.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Work you do earlier still counts. The checklist's biggest pieces are 300 stunts (the trophy only needs 250), 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Most of the roughly 200-hour platinum run is this checklist.
